verdict.rationale: Poke documents an API for sending messages from scripts and automation tools, and says CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, or monitoring tools can trigger it. It also ships an `npx poke` CLI for login, tunnels and adding MCP servers. That means the product can be triggered from CI, but there is no documented headless execution mode. The docs show no way to run tasks non-interactively and capture structured results; Poke remains a messaging-channel assistant that CI can only poke. Missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive task execution with returned output, CI auth (token/API key) guidance, a published API spec (OpenAPI probes 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.
